text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali looks at programmes for making Tunisia a regional cultural capital in 1997.
- President Ali names Mongi Bousnina as envoy in Paris and Slaheddine Ben M'Barek in Bonn.
- Tunisians find difficulties getting entry visas for European countries. French consul general Philippe Bossiere says more than 55,000 visas are delivered each year in Tunisia.
